name: Prismic
description: Prismic headless page builder: query published and scheduled documents with Prismic filters, read custom type and slice models, browse and upload media, and create or update draft documents through the Migration API.
instructions:
## Prismic
This connector reads a Prismic repository through the **Content API** (`https://<repository>.cdn.prismic.io/api/v2`) and writes through Prismic's write APIs: the **Migration API** for documents, the **Asset API** for the media library, and the **Types API** to read the content models. Prismic also runs its own MCP server (`https://mcp.prismic.io/mcp`, OAuth sign-in) for editing and publishing from an assistant; this connector is the token-based alternative.

**Setup (3 minutes)**
1. `PRISMIC_REPOSITORY`: the repository name, the part before `.prismic.io` in your dashboard URL.
2. `PRISMIC_ACCESS_TOKEN` (optional): only when the Content API is private. Repository **Settings > API & Security**, generate an access token (or `npx prismic token create`). Leave it empty for a public API.
3. `PRISMIC_WRITE_TOKEN` (optional, needed for every tool marked "Needs the write token" and for all writes): **Settings > API & Security > Write APIs**, generate a token (or `npx prismic token create --write`). It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` with the `repository` header. It carries wide rights: keep it to trusted workspaces.
4. Run `prismic_get_repository` to check the repository name.

**Reading content (two steps)**
1. `prismic_get_repository` returns `refs`. Take the `ref` of the entry with `isMasterRef: true` (published content), or a release's ref to preview scheduled content. Every content query needs it, and it changes on each publish.
2. Then `prismic_search_documents` with filters in `q`, `prismic_get_document` by id, `prismic_get_document_by_uid` by type and UID, or `prismic_list_documents_by_type`. The repository answer also lists the custom types, tags and languages.

**Filters (`q`)**: `[[at(document.type,"blog_post")]]`; combine several: `[[at(document.type,"blog_post")][any(document.tags,["news","events"])]]`. Others: `fulltext(document,"text")`, `at(my.blog_post.author,"<id>")`, `date.after(document.first_publication_date,"2026-01-01")`, `not`, `in(document.id,[...])`, `number.lt(my.product.price,100)`. `orderings` such as `[my.blog_post.date desc]`.

**Models and media (write token)**: `prismic_list_custom_types` and `prismic_get_custom_type` give the field structure, `prismic_list_shared_slices` and `prismic_get_shared_slice` the slices. `prismic_list_assets` browses the media library, `prismic_upload_asset` uploads a file from a URL, `prismic_update_asset` edits alt text, credits and notes.

**Writing documents (write token)**: `prismic_create_document` and `prismic_update_document` save drafts into a **migration release**: they are not live until an editor publishes that release in the dashboard (Migration Releases tab). There is no publish call in these APIs. Build `data` from the custom type model; rich text is a list of blocks (`{"type": "paragraph", "text": "...", "spans": []}`), images and media take an asset id, links `{"link_type": "Document", "id": "..."}` or `{"link_type": "Web", "url": "..."}`. An update replaces all content and tags. Changing content models and deleting are left to the Prismic dashboard or CLI.

**Reading the answers**: content lists carry `results`, `page`, `total_pages`, `total_results_size` and `next_page`. Rich text fields come as block lists; dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`, timestamps ISO 8601. Document ids look like `ZMI65RQAADkECUFM`.

**Paging**: `page` (from 1) and `page_size` (20 by default, 100 at most), or `orderings` plus `after` with the last document id. Assets page with `cursor`.

**Limits and errors**: the Content API allows 200 uncached requests per second and URLs up to 2,048 characters (keep `graph_query` short). The Migration and Asset APIs take one request per second per repository. 404 on `prismic_get_repository` means a wrong repository name; 401 or 403 a private API without a valid access token, or a write call without a valid write token; 400 a malformed filter or an invalid ref; 422 data that does not fit the model.
prerequisites: A Prismic repository; an access token if its Content API is private, and a write token for models, media and writes.

PRISMIC_REPOSITORY.label: Repository name
PRISMIC_REPOSITORY.help: The name of your repository, the part before .prismic.io in the dashboard URL.
PRISMIC_REPOSITORY.patternMessage: Only the repository name in lower case, e.g. your-repo-name, without https:// or .prismic.io.

PRISMIC_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Content API access token
PRISMIC_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: Only for a private Content API: repository Settings > API & Security > generate an access token. Leave empty when the API is public.
PRISMIC_ACCESS_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without spaces or quotes.

PRISMIC_WRITE_TOKEN.label: Write token
PRISMIC_WRITE_TOKEN.help: For the Types, Asset and Migration APIs: repository Settings > API & Security > Write APIs > generate a token. Sent as a Bearer token.
PRISMIC_WRITE_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without spaces, quotes or a Bearer prefix.

verifyHints.404: Prismic does not know this repository. Check PRISMIC_REPOSITORY: only the name, e.g. your-repo-name.
verifyHints.401: The Content API of this repository is private. Set PRISMIC_ACCESS_TOKEN from Settings > API & Security.
verifyHints.403: Prismic refused the token. Generate a new access token, or a write token for the Types, Asset and Migration APIs, under Settings > API & Security.

tools.name: prismic_get_repository
tools.description: The repository's entry point for the Content API: refs (the master ref needed by every content query, plus release refs), custom types, tags, languages and bookmarks. Call it first.

tools.name: prismic_search_documents
tools.description: Query published content (or a release) with Prismic filters: by type, tag, id, uid, field values, full text or dates, sorted and paged. Returns results with id, uid, type, lang, tags, first and last publication dates and data (the fields), plus total_results_size and total_pages.

ref.description: Content version to read: the ref of the master ref (isMasterRef true) from prismic_get_repository, or a release ref for scheduled content. Refs change on every publish: fetch a fresh one when the API answers that the ref is unknown or expired.

q.description: Filters, each in brackets, all inside brackets: [[at(document.type,"blog_post")][fulltext(document,"pricing")][any(document.tags,["news"])][date.after(document.first_publication_date,"2026-01-01")][at(my.blog_post.author,"<document id>")]].

after.description: Return documents after this document id (with orderings), for cursor paging.

lang.description: Locale code, e.g. en-us or fr-fr; * for all locales. Default: the master locale.

fetch_links.description: Fields of linked documents to include, e.g. author.name,author.avatar.

graph_query.description: GraphQuery string for selective or deep fetching, e.g. {blog_post{title author{...on author{name}}}}.

tools.name: prismic_get_document
tools.description: One document by its id with all its fields (data), slices, tags, alternate languages and publication dates.

ref.description: Content version to read: the ref of the master ref (isMasterRef true) from prismic_get_repository, or a release ref for scheduled content. Refs change on every publish: fetch a fresh one when the API answers that the ref is unknown or expired.

lang.description: Locale code, e.g. en-us or fr-fr; * for all locales. Default: the master locale.

fetch_links.description: Fields of linked documents to include, e.g. author.name,author.avatar.

graph_query.description: GraphQuery string for selective or deep fetching, e.g. {blog_post{title author{...on author{name}}}}.

tools.name: prismic_get_document_by_uid
tools.description: One document by its custom type and UID (the slug-like unique id), e.g. type page and uid about-us.

ref.description: Content version to read: the ref of the master ref (isMasterRef true) from prismic_get_repository, or a release ref for scheduled content. Refs change on every publish: fetch a fresh one when the API answers that the ref is unknown or expired.

type.description: API id of the custom type, e.g. page or blog_post.

lang.description: Locale code, e.g. en-us or fr-fr; * for all locales. Default: the master locale.

fetch_links.description: Fields of linked documents to include, e.g. author.name,author.avatar.

graph_query.description: GraphQuery string for selective or deep fetching, e.g. {blog_post{title author{...on author{name}}}}.

tools.name: prismic_list_documents_by_type
tools.description: All documents of one custom type, paged and optionally sorted, e.g. every blog_post newest first.

ref.description: Content version to read: the ref of the master ref (isMasterRef true) from prismic_get_repository, or a release ref for scheduled content. Refs change on every publish: fetch a fresh one when the API answers that the ref is unknown or expired.

type.description: API id of the custom type, e.g. blog_post.

lang.description: Locale code, e.g. en-us or fr-fr; * for all locales. Default: the master locale.

fetch_links.description: Fields of linked documents to include, e.g. author.name,author.avatar.

graph_query.description: GraphQuery string for selective or deep fetching, e.g. {blog_post{title author{...on author{name}}}}.

tools.name: prismic_list_custom_types
tools.description: The custom types (page types) of the repository with their JSON model: tabs, fields, slice zones, repeatable or single, and status (active or disabled). Needs the write token.

tools.name: prismic_get_custom_type
tools.description: One custom type model by its API id, with every field and its configuration. Use it before creating or updating documents of that type. Needs the write token.

type_id.description: API id of the custom type, e.g. blog_post.

tools.name: prismic_list_shared_slices
tools.description: The shared slices of the repository with their variations and fields (primary and items). Needs the write token.

tools.name: prismic_get_shared_slice
tools.description: One shared slice model by id, with its variations and fields. Needs the write token.

tools.name: prismic_list_assets
tools.description: Assets of the media library: id, url, filename, kind, size, width and height, alt, credits, notes and tags. Filter by type or keyword; paged with a cursor. Needs the write token.

asset_type.description: Asset type, e.g. all or image.

keyword.description: Keyword to match in title, filename, alt, notes or credits.

cursor.description: Asset id after which to continue, from the previous answer's cursor.

tools.name: prismic_upload_asset
tools.description: Upload a file from a public URL to the media library, with optional alt text, credits and notes. Returns the asset id to use in image or media link fields. One upload per second.

file_url.description: Public URL of the file to upload (fetched by the connector, 10 MB at most).

tools.name: prismic_update_asset
tools.description: Change the alt text, credits or notes of a media library asset.

asset_id.description: Asset id from prismic_list_assets or prismic_upload_asset.

tools.name: prismic_create_document
tools.description: Create a document as a draft through the Migration API. It lands in a migration release, where an editor reviews and publishes it. data must follow the custom type model (prismic_get_custom_type). One write per second.

title.description: Title shown in the document list.

type.description: API id of the custom type.

uid.description: UID; required when the type has one, not allowed when it has none.

alternate_language_id.description: Id of the document this one translates.

data.description: Field values keyed by field API id, e.g. {"title": [{"type": "heading1", "text": "Hello", "spans": []}], "image": {"id": "<asset id>"}, "link": {"link_type": "Document", "id": "<doc id>"}, "slices": [{"slice_type": "text", "variation": "default", "primary": {...}}]}.

tools.name: prismic_update_document
tools.description: Replace the content of an existing document through the Migration API, saved as a draft in a migration release. data replaces the whole content, and tags left out are removed: read the document first and send everything back. Type and locale cannot change.

uid.description: UID; required when the type has one.

title.description: Title shown in the document list.

tags.description: Tags; omitting them deletes the existing ones.

data.description: The full content, as for prismic_create_document.
